name: archive_session
description: Archive a conversation (leaves the active list; reversible)

name: attach_integration_credential
description: Attach a credential from the company's own vault: `integration_id`, `secret_ref` (secret name; the `platform/` namespace is reserved) and `auth_kind` (`bearer`, `api_key`, `tunnel`). One credential per integration; it cannot be replaced afterwards

arguments.name: integration_id
arguments.desc: An integration owned by this tenant

arguments.name: secret_ref
arguments.desc: Secret name in the tenant vault. The platform/ namespace is reserved.

name: cancel_agent_turn
description: Cancel an in-progress agent turn (mid-LLM, mid-tool, mid-stream). Useful for loop runaway, off-target responses, or compliance stops. In multi-agent (sub-agent) sessions, propagates via `root_execution_id`

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: Optional cancellation reason recorded in the operation audit log

name: cancel_process_instance
description: Cancel a running process instance. Returns a `command_id` with status `received` — read the outcome with `get_process_command`

arguments.name: reason_note
arguments.desc: Cancellation reason, recorded with the operator in the server audit log, not in the instance trail

name: chat_with_agent
description: Send a message to a published agent. This executes the agent, consumes tokens and may cause external side effects. Reuse session_id for conversation context and client_message_id for idempotent retries. Shared admin/owner integrations must provide consumer_key to enable person-scoped memory. Returns response, execution/session identifiers, usage and structured blocks. See https://docs.zihin.ai/agents/invocation-contract.

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: Message to send to the agent

arguments.name: attachments
arguments.desc: Attachments by bucket path only; URLs and base64 are not accepted. Available only to the person who owns the file, through a member key or personal OAuth. Other keys receive this field in ignored_fields.

arguments.name: bindings
arguments.desc: Values injected into agent tool arguments through defaults_from_context or ${context.x}. Never sent to the model or stored. Requires an admin or owner key.

arguments.name: client_message_id
arguments.desc: Client-generated UUID for 24-hour idempotency per agent and person/key. Reusing the same ID and message replays the response without execution; an active turn returns SESSION_BUSY; a different message returns IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT.

arguments.name: consumer_channel
arguments.desc: Original consumer channel, such as whatsapp, email, web or api. Requires consumer_key and an admin/owner key. Lowercase free text; defaults to mcp. Distinct from the MCP transport.

arguments.name: consumer_display_name
arguments.desc: Display name for consumer_key. Requires consumer_key and an admin/owner key. Updates the profile and current conversation; completed conversations retain their historical name.

arguments.name: consumer_key
arguments.desc: Identity of the person represented by the message, such as an external user ID or digits-only phone number. Scopes personal memory and engagement. Only admin/owner keys may declare it; editor keys ignore it, while member keys and personal OAuth already identify their person. Without it, operator keys run without memory. Reusing another person's session_id returns CONFLICT; omit it for a new conversation. A session without an identity adopts the first declared identity and remains bound to it.

arguments.name: context
arguments.desc: Source-system data available to the agent (for example, userName). Flat scalar values only, up to 2000 characters. Sent with the user message, never in the system prompt. Secret-named fields are redacted. Requires an admin or owner key.

arguments.name: metadata
arguments.desc: Opaque correlation metadata, such as trace_id. Never sent to the model; stored with secret redaction in the execution. list_executions can filter trace_id. Flat scalars only, at most 20 keys and 4 KB.

arguments.name: session_from
arguments.desc: Names of context/bindings fields defining the conversation, for example ["customerId"]. Creates a session on first use and reuses the same derived identity. Do not combine with session_id. Requires an admin or owner key.

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Session ID from a previous call. Reuse it to retain conversation context; omit for the first message.

arguments.name: timeout_ms
arguments.desc: Requested turn deadline in milliseconds; can only shorten the channel deadline. Values below 1000 are ignored and reported in ignored_fields. Expiry returns TIMEOUT/TURN_TIMEOUT.

name: clear_session
description: Irreversibly clear conversation history while preserving the conversation record. Returns SESSION_BUSY during an active turn or SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE when the delivery lock is unavailable. Requires the HTTP backend.

name: clone_agent
description: Clone agent with schemas and optionally triggers

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the agent to clone

arguments.name: include_triggers
arguments.desc: Clone triggers; cloned triggers are initially disabled

arguments.name: new_name
arguments.desc: Clone name; omit to use the generated name

name: compare_versions
description: Compare two recorded versions of a configuration resource and inspect their changes.

arguments.name: from_version
arguments.desc: Source version, normally the older version

arguments.name: to_version
arguments.desc: Target version, normally the newer version

name: create_agent
description: Create a draft agent and return its UUID. Add a persona with create_schema (persona_config), then publish_agent. Returns PLAN_LIMIT_REACHED when the tenant agent limit is reached. Read zihin://skills/criar-agente.

arguments.name: commercial_name
arguments.desc: Display name shown to end users

arguments.name: llm_config
arguments.desc: Model configuration. model uses provider.model or auto; temperature ranges from 0 to 2; fallback_chain is an ordered model list.

arguments.name: type
arguments.desc: Agent type; orchestrator can invoke other agents through invoke_agent

name: create_api_key
description: Create API Key with role (anti-escalation enforced)

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: API key name, for example ERP Webhook or Production n8n

arguments.name: expires_in_days
arguments.desc: Days until expiry; omit for no expiry

arguments.name: prefix
arguments.desc: Key prefix: zhn_live_ for production, zhn_test_ for testing, zhn_dev_ for development

arguments.name: rate_limit_per_minute
arguments.desc: Requests per minute, an integer of at least 1, validated against the tenant plan

arguments.name: role
arguments.desc: RBAC role: admin has full access; editor has consumer and builder-read access; member has consumer access. Cannot exceed the caller's role.

name: create_approval_policy
description: Create a policy. `stages[].approvers` accepts `{type:"user", id}` or `{type:"role", role}`

arguments.name: stages
arguments.desc: Approval stages; currently one stage with min_approvals=1

name: create_csp
description: Create a contextual security policy with tenant, team, agent or user scope. Read zihin://schemas/csp_config: unknown rule fields may be accepted but have no effect. behavior.must_not_tools blocks named tools; execution ceilings use max_iterations, max_tool_calls and max_tokens_per_request. Native-chat human approval uses require_approval_for with tool names or matchers (tool_name, mcp_server_id, source=mcp|api) and approval_policy_id. Data rules are model instructions, not programmatic masking. origin policies are stored but not enforced; never use them as an access-control boundary. Custom rules become prompt instructions. See zihin://skills/governanca-e-operacao for examples.

arguments.name: rules
arguments.desc: Policy rules; structure depends on the policy type. See zihin://schemas/csp_config.

arguments.name: exceptions
arguments.desc: Rule exceptions using the same structure as rules; overrides specific fields

arguments.name: priority
arguments.desc: Priority; higher values take precedence. Defaults to 0.

arguments.name: scope_target_id
arguments.desc: Target ID; required for team, agent and user scopes

name: create_integration
description: Register an integration: `kind` (`tunnel`, `api`, `mcp`), `name`, `target`, `shareable`, `limits`. `target` and `limits` are **immutable** — to change them, create another integration

arguments.name: limits
arguments.desc: Access limits; immutable after creation. Create a new integration to expand its scope.

arguments.name: shareable
arguments.desc: Whether the integration can be shared; defaults to false

arguments.name: target
arguments.desc: Destination descriptor, such as tunnel origin/path, base_url or server reference. Immutable after creation.

name: create_mcp_server
description: Register an external MCP server for an agent. Use http (Streamable HTTP) or stdio (local development). Authentication: none; bearer with config.vault_secret_id; api_key with vault_secret_id and optional api_key_header; tunnel uses platform authentication. timeout controls connection and tool discovery; call_timeout_ms controls each tool call (1000–120000 ms, default 30000). Timed-out calls are not retried automatically. Read zihin://schemas/mcp_resource_config for headers and defaults_from_context.

arguments.name: auth_method
arguments.desc: Authentication method; OAuth is not yet supported for this external-server configuration

arguments.name: config
arguments.desc: Additional configuration: vault_secret_id, headers, connection timeout and per-tool call_timeout_ms

arguments.name: integration_id
arguments.desc: Optional registered integration link; see list_integrations. With tunnel authentication, destination access requires an active integration grant. For other authentication methods, the link is informational.

name: create_schema
description: Create schema with integrated validation

arguments.name: schema_data
arguments.desc: Schema data. Read zihin://schemas/{schema_type}. persona_config requires editor_schema.persona.role (at least 3 characters) and objective (at least 10). api_config requires tool_definition and editor_schema.api; endpoint.name must equal tool_definition.name. Path parameters use ${name} and must appear in input_schema. Authentication uses prefix and secret_ref, not type; Basic credentials must already be base64 encoded. API timeout_ms is 1000–120000, default 30000. Define nested objects with their own properties. Endpoint transformations: default_body, locked_fields, field_mapping, array_fields, body_format and defaults_from_context. Context defaults are authoritative and override model values when present. workflow_config uses editor_schema.workflow with name, mode (strict|guided|flexible), steps (id, name, description, optional type) and optional transitions. skill_config uses a skill wrapper with name (at least 3 characters), instructions (50–5000 characters) and optional priority (0–1000, higher first). CSPs are separate entities; configure multi-agent limits through a behavior CSP.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Legacy field with no effect. The name belongs inside schema_data, such as tool_definition.name or skill.name.

name: create_secret
description: Create an encrypted tenant secret. Save its value before submitting; plaintext is not returned afterward. Reference its name as secret_ref in API tools, MCP servers and trigger callbacks. Names starting with platform/ are reserved.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Unique tenant secret name, such as ERP_API_KEY or CRM_WEBHOOK_TOKEN

arguments.name: value
arguments.desc: Valor plaintext a ser criptografado (ex: a API key ou o token)

arguments.name: category
arguments.desc: Secret category, for organization only; database is a legacy category

arguments.name: usage_hint
arguments.desc: Informational usage hint, such as bearer_token, api_key, password or oauth_client. Does not change runtime behavior.

name: create_trigger
description: Create a webhook, schedule or email trigger. Read zihin://schemas/trigger_config and use its exact enums. The server supplies tenant and record identifiers. The returned call block contains method, URL and authentication instructions; it does not return the API key value. Read zihin://skills/triggers-e-canais.

arguments.name: api_key_id
arguments.desc: API key UUID for authenticated execution

arguments.name: trigger_config
arguments.desc: Trigger configuration; read zihin://schemas/trigger_config. WEBHOOK: query_extraction uses field or full_body; response_adapter selects raw, ebarn, slack, teams or twiml. context_mapping maps request fields; session_strategy uses derive or ephemeral; sender_access uses any, members or whitelist. execution uses sync or async, with optional acknowledgement and authenticated callback. message_buffer groups rapid messages (window_ms 1000–30000, default 5000; max_messages 1–50, default 10). split_config splits long responses. TwiML defaults strip_markdown=true and max_length=4096; override through callback.response_transform. SCHEDULE: cron and query_template are required; timezone defaults to America/Sao_Paulo. Each execution opens a new session. output.channel supports silent, webhook, callback or user. User delivery requires target (user_id or consumer_key); push is optional. Scheduled results are messages, not memory configuration. EMAIL: inbound_address, allowed_senders with mode all|domain|email and the matching domains/emails list, plus optional subject_filter.

name: delete_agent
description: Archive an agent: remove it from listings and stop it responding. Restore through the Zihin console; this server has no restore tool.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the agent to archive

name: delete_agent_memory
description: Delete one persistent agent memory. Platform control entries are protected and cannot be removed here.

arguments.name: user_key
arguments.desc: Identity of the end user who owns the memory

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: Memory scope; defaults to agent_user. The same key can exist in different scopes.

name: delete_api_key
description: Revoke a tenant API key. Requests using that credential will no longer be authorized.

arguments.name: key_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the API key to revoke

name: delete_csp
description: Permanently remove a contextual security policy and immediately remove its restrictions. Use toggle_csp to suspend it reversibly.

arguments.name: csp_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the CSP policy to remove

name: delete_mcp_server
description: Permanently remove an external MCP server from the agent configuration.

arguments.name: mcp_server_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the MCP server to remove

name: delete_schema
description: Permanently remove an agent configuration schema. Its behavior or tool will no longer be available to the agent.

arguments.name: schema_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the schema to deactivate

name: delete_secret
description: Permanently delete a tenant secret. API tools, MCP servers and trigger callbacks that reference it will stop working.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Name of the secret to remove

name: delete_trigger
description: Permanently remove a trigger and stop its configured automation.

arguments.name: trigger_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the trigger to remove

name: disable_process
description: Remove permission to open new instances of a process, or use * for all. Existing instances continue. Permissions provided by server configuration cannot be removed here.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: Process definition key, or * for all published definitions in the tenant

name: enable_process
description: Allow agents in this tenant to open a published process, or use * for all published processes. Takes effect immediately on this replica without restarting.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: Process definition key, or * for all published definitions in the tenant

name: get_agent
description: Retrieve an agent configuration by UUID within the current tenant.

name: get_agent_budget
description: Get the current agent spending cap and cycle balance in USD. Includes all model calls, including BYOK; unlimited=true means no cap.

name: get_agent_full
description: Complete agent view (schemas + triggers + CSPs)

name: get_agent_lineage
description: Orchestrator→sub-agent pairs that **actually invoked** each other (via `invoke_agent`), with invocation counts — complements `allowed_invoke_agents` (which is "may invoke")

name: get_agent_metrics
description: Execution metrics by period (`1d`, `7d`, `30d`): LLM calls, errors, success rate, tokens, cost, p50/p95 latency (aggregated server-side — no row cap), tool usage (sampled, with `sample_truncated` disclosure) and sessions

name: get_api_key
description: Retrieve metadata for a tenant API key. The secret key value is not returned.

name: get_approval_policy
description: Policy details (name, stages, approvers, `is_active`)

name: get_consumer_profile
description: Get aggregated consumer profile (cross-session, cross-agent): display name, channels used, total sessions, total turns, agents interacted, product flags, timestamps

arguments.name: consumer_key
arguments.desc: Consumer identifier (normalized external user ID or email). Must match the session consumer_key.

name: get_csp
description: Retrieve one contextual security policy and its configured rules.

name: get_effective_csps
description: Inspect the contextual security policies effective for the requested scope.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.desc: Agent UUID for resolving agent-scoped policies

arguments.name: team_id
arguments.desc: Team UUID for resolving team-scoped policies

arguments.name: user_id
arguments.desc: User UUID for resolving user-scoped policies

name: get_execution_diagnostics
description: Get execution diagnostics: chronological model and tool calls, tokens, latency, model, finish_reason, cache reads/writes and caller correlation metadata. Use the execution_id or root_execution_id returned by chat_with_agent.

arguments.name: execution_id
arguments.desc: Execution UUID or root_execution_id returned by an agent invocation

name: get_execution_trace
description: Hierarchical multi-agent execution trace from a `root_execution_id`: supervisor→sub-agents with phases, tool calls and cost per node

name: get_mcp_server
description: Retrieve an external MCP server configuration by its UUID.

name: get_process_command
description: Outcome of an intervention command: `received` (not applied yet), `applied` or `rejected` (with `reason`). Query this instead of repeating the mutation

arguments.name: command_id
arguments.desc: Command UUID returned by cancel_process_instance or resolve_process_incident

name: get_process_definition
description: Get a complete process definition and its version history. Omit version for the latest published version; inspect it before publishing a new one.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: Process definition key, such as review-customer-record

arguments.name: version
arguments.desc: Specific version in any status; omit for the latest published version

name: get_process_engine_status
description: Whether the engine is enabled for the tenant

name: get_process_instance
description: Inspect a process instance. Editors see status, steps, agent, name and dates. Admin/owner roles also see redacted variables, human tasks, file metadata and computation summaries.

name: get_process_trail
description: Read a process instance audit trail in order, including transitions, triggering events/commands and reasons. Sensitive values are redacted. Requires admin or owner.

arguments.name: after_sequence
arguments.desc: Continue after this sequence; use next_after_sequence from the previous response

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Maximum transitions per call; defaults to 200, maximum 1000

name: get_scheduler_status
description: Status of active scheduled triggers (cron jobs)

name: get_schema
description: Retrieve one agent configuration schema and its current version.

name: get_session_agent_tree
description: Agent tree of a **session** (by parent-session lineage): supervisor + sub-agents across all turns — works where per-execution traces can't close the tree in multi-turn sessions

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Anchor session_id, usually the supervisor's session

arguments.name: execution_id
arguments.desc: Optionally restrict the tree to one execution

name: get_session_history
description: Message history of a session, read from the durable record and paginated with `before`/`limit`/`next_before` (user/assistant messages only; attachments as metadata) — see [below](https://docs.zihin.ai/integrations/mcp-server#get_session_history)

arguments.name: session_id
arguments.desc: Session ID returned by chat_with_agent or list_agent_sessions

arguments.name: before
arguments.desc: Pagination cursor: use the previous page's next_before value unchanged

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Messages per page, newest before the cursor; defaults to 50, maximum 100

name: get_session_trigger_context
description: Reverse lookup: given a `session_id`, returns the trigger and execution that originated the session

name: get_snapshot
description: Retrieve a publication snapshot and inspect its saved configuration before restoration.

name: get_tenant_health
description: Tenant-level infra errors **not attributable to a specific agent** (provider auth, rate limit), grouped by canonical error code

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: End of the time window in ISO 8601 format; omit for no end filter

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: Start of the time window in ISO 8601 format; omit for no start filter

name: get_trigger
description: Retrieve a trigger and its current configuration before inspection or update.

name: get_trigger_execution
description: Retrieve one trigger execution and its recorded outcome for troubleshooting.

name: get_version
description: Retrieve one recorded resource version for inspection before restoring it.

name: grant_integration
description: Give a consumer access: `integration_id`, `consumer_tenant_id`, optional `consumer_agent_id` (absent = the whole company), `allowed_operations` (absent or empty = **all** operations) and `expires_at` (ISO 8601). The grant is created **active** and applies on the consumer's next call

arguments.name: integration_id
arguments.desc: An integration owned by this tenant

arguments.name: allowed_operations
arguments.desc: Allowed operation names, such as tools or endpoints

arguments.name: consumer_agent_id
arguments.desc: Restrict access to one consumer agent; omit for the entire consumer tenant

arguments.name: expires_at
arguments.desc: Optional expiry timestamp in ISO 8601 format

name: invalidate_mcp_cache
description: Invalidate cached discovery for an external MCP server after its available tools change.

arguments.name: mcp_server_id
arguments.desc: Specific MCP server UUID; omit to invalidate all MCP caches for the tenant

name: list_agent_budgets
description: Get current USD spending caps and balances for all tenant agents in one call. Includes BYOK usage.

name: list_agent_history
description: List an agent's recorded change history to investigate configuration changes.

name: list_agent_memory
description: List persistent memory entries for an agent

arguments.name: before
arguments.desc: Pagination cursor: updated_at from the previous page's last entry

arguments.name: include
arguments.desc: Include the consumer's original statement that produced the memory. Contains personal data. Requires admin/owner; ignored for other roles.

arguments.name: scope
arguments.desc: Memory scope; agent_user is person-scoped. The same memory key can exist in different scopes.

arguments.name: user_key
arguments.desc: Filter by user_key identifying the end user

name: list_agent_sessions
description: List recent conversations with an agent, newest first; status selects active (default) or archived sessions. Members see their own sessions; operators see tenant sessions. message_count and last_message_preview cover up to 50 recent messages, while total counts all matching sessions. offset must be a multiple of limit.

arguments.name: offset
arguments.desc: Pagination offset; must be a multiple of limit

arguments.name: roots_only
arguments.desc: true returns root sessions only, excluding sub-agent sessions

name: list_agent_tools
description: All resolved tools (api_config + MCP + core), with `resolved`/`error` status

name: list_agents
description: List tenant agents (filters: `status`, `type`, `include_archived`)

arguments.name: include_unpublished
arguments.desc: Include agents whose publication is inactive in this tenant. Use this to find and republish an agent removed from the list after unpublishing.

arguments.name: type
arguments.desc: Filter by agent type, such as assistant or chatbot

name: list_api_keys
description: List tenant API key metadata without exposing secret key values.

name: list_approval_policies
description: Approval policies (filter `active_only`)

name: list_approvals
description: Pending approval requests for the tenant. `admin`/`owner` see all; `editor` is scoped to own requests + what they can approve

name: list_consumer_sessions
description: Paginated list of a specific consumer's sessions (cross-agent, most recent first) — complements `get_consumer_profile`, which returns only aggregated counters

arguments.name: consumer_key
arguments.desc: Consumer identity, matching consumer_key in sessions

name: list_consumers
description: Paginated list of consumers, ordered by `last_seen_at` (desc). Filters: `search` (substring in display_name or consumer_key), `blocked` (true = only denylisted, false = only not-denylisted)

arguments.name: blocked
arguments.desc: true returns denylisted consumers; false returns others; omit for all

arguments.name: search
arguments.desc: Case-insensitive substring in display_name or consumer_key, up to 80 characters

name: list_csps
description: List contextual security policies in the current tenant.

arguments.name: is_active
arguments.desc: Filter by active or inactive status

arguments.name: scope_target_id
arguments.desc: Filter by target ID: agent_id, team_id or user_id

name: list_executions
description: Search the tenant's agent executions, most recent first, with pagination (`page`, `limit`). Filters: `trace_id` (the correlation id the integrator sent in `metadata.trace_id`), `session_id`, `agent_id`, `status`, `source` (`chat`, `sse`, `mcp_server`, `webhook`, `schedule`, `email`, `task`, `builder`, `process`), `start_date`/`end_date` (ISO 8601). Same as `GET /api/v1/executions`. For one execution's detail use `get_execution_diagnostics`; for the multi-agent tree, `get_execution_trace`

arguments.name: end_date
arguments.desc: ISO 8601 timestamp; include records created at or before this time

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Results per page; defaults to 20, maximum 100

arguments.name: source
arguments.desc: Invocation source: chat, sse, mcp_server, webhook, schedule, email, task, builder or process

arguments.name: start_date
arguments.desc: ISO 8601 timestamp; include records created at or after this time

arguments.name: trace_id
arguments.desc: Integrator correlation ID, supplied as metadata.trace_id

name: list_integration_grants
description: Grants where this company is the owner (`as: "owner"`, what it gives) or the consumer (`as: "consumer"`, the default — what it receives)

arguments.name: as
arguments.desc: owner lists grants this tenant issued; consumer lists access granted to this tenant

name: list_integrations
description: Integrations **this** company owns (`items`, `total`)

name: list_mcp_servers
description: List the external MCP servers configured for an agent.

name: list_process_definitions
description: List the latest published definition for each process key in the tenant, including its version, steps and availability to agents. Agents open instances with open_process.

name: list_process_instances
description: List tenant process instances, newest first, with status, current step and owner. Filter by open/closed state or definition; use get_process_instance for details.

arguments.name: before
arguments.desc: Opaque pagination cursor: next_before from the previous page

arguments.name: definition_key
arguments.desc: Process definition key, such as review-customer-record

arguments.name: limit
arguments.desc: Items per page; defaults to 20, maximum 50

arguments.name: open
arguments.desc: true returns running instances; false returns completed instances; omit for all

name: list_published_agents
description: List published agents available for chat

name: list_schemas
description: List schemas for an agent (filters: `schema_type`, `include_inactive`)

name: list_secrets
description: List tenant secret metadata without exposing credential values. Use each name as secret_ref where supported.

name: list_snapshots
description: List an agent's publication snapshots available for inspection or restoration.

name: list_trigger_executions
description: List execution records for a trigger to inspect recent runs and delivery results.

name: list_triggers
description: List triggers (filters: `agent_id`, `trigger_type`, `enabled`)

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.desc: true returns enabled triggers; false returns disabled triggers; omit for all

name: list_versions
description: List recorded versions of a configuration resource for inspection or rollback.

name: publish_agent
description: Publish agent (validates all schemas first)

name: publish_process_definition
description: Publish the next version of a process definition. New instances use it; existing instances retain their original version. Validate first. Worker request recipes belong to the definition; agents select among its allowed recipes.

arguments.name: spec
arguments.desc: Complete process definition without version; the platform assigns the next version

name: ratify_integration_grant
description: Confirm a provisional grant (`pending_ratification` → `active`), e.g. one registered by a migration. Repeating it on an active grant returns the grant unchanged

name: resolve_process_incident
description: Resolve an incident of a process instance (same `command_id` pattern)

arguments.name: resolution
arguments.desc: retry reruns the step; abandon ends the path; substitute_output supplies the step output

arguments.name: task_id
arguments.desc: Incident identifier when the instance has more than one open incident

name: retire_process_definition
description: Retire all published versions of a process key to prevent new instances. Existing instances continue. Publish a new version to make the process available again.

arguments.name: key
arguments.desc: Process definition key, such as review-customer-record

name: revoke_integration_grant
description: Revoke a grant. Takes effect on the next call. A revoked grant cannot be reactivated — grant again instead. Repeating it returns the grant unchanged

name: rollback_snapshot
description: Restore an agent from a previous publication snapshot, overwriting its current configuration, schemas, triggers and MCP servers. Inspect get_snapshot before restoring.

arguments.name: snapshot_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the snapshot to restore

name: rollback_version
description: Restore a resource from a recorded version, replacing its current configuration.

name: send_manual_message
description: Send a manual operator message through the same outbound channel as the agent (Twilio/Meta/webhook). Requires `control_mode != engaged`. Message is recorded as human-authored so the agent doesn't imitate the style if it resumes

arguments.name: idempotency_key
arguments.desc: Optional idempotency key (1–200 characters). If omitted, it is derived from the message text within a 60-second window.

name: set_agent_budget
description: Set or remove the cap (`limit_usd: null` = unlimited). Also the recovery loop: raising the cap lets a budget-stopped agent run again on the next turn

arguments.name: limit_usd
arguments.desc: Spending cap in USD, at least zero; null removes the cap

name: set_consumer_denylist
description: Add or remove a consumer from the tenant-wide denylist. When active, all messages from that consumer are bypassed cross-agent (no LLM, no quota)

arguments.name: blocked
arguments.desc: true adds the consumer to the denylist; false removes it

arguments.name: consumer_key
arguments.desc: Consumer identity, matching consumer_key in sessions

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: Optional fixed message returned when the consumer attempts to interact. Empty means a silent acknowledgement (default). Used only when blocked=true.

arguments.name: reason
arguments.desc: Optional audit reason; used only when blocked=true

name: set_engagement_control
description: End or restore the engagement between one agent and one consumer, without blocking the consumer tenant-wide. Evaluated after the tenant denylist and before session control

arguments.name: action
arguments.desc: canned stops engagement and returns the fixed message; engage resumes engagement

arguments.name: user_key
arguments.desc: Consumer identity, using the same key as consumer_key and person-scoped memory

arguments.name: expires_in_days
arguments.desc: Control expiry in days; omit for no expiry

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: Required for canned mode. Plain text without links or HTML.

name: set_session_control
description: Change a session's `control_mode` (`engaged`, `suspended`, `manual_handoff`). When `≠ engaged`, the agent loop is bypassed for new messages on that session

arguments.name: mode
arguments.desc: engaged resumes normal operation; suspended pauses; manual_handoff transfers control to a human

arguments.name: expires_at
arguments.desc: Optional expiry (ISO 8601 with timezone, for example 2026-10-05T12:00:00Z; at most 30 days) for suspended/manual_handoff mode. At expiry, the session returns to engaged automatically. Omitted means no expiry; another call without expires_at CLEARS the previous expiry. Repeat it to change only the message.

arguments.name: message
arguments.desc: Optional fixed response. Empty means a silent acknowledgement. Applies only when mode is not engaged.

name: test_mcp_server
description: Perform a real MCP handshake and list external tools to check connectivity, authentication and protocol compatibility. Updates the stored server status, last error and protocol version. success=true means the test ran; reachable is its result. Inspect error_class and error_message when unreachable.

arguments.name: mcp_server_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the MCP server to test

name: test_trigger
description: Execute a trigger with a test payload. This runs the agent, consumes tokens and may cause external side effects.

arguments.name: trigger_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the trigger to test

arguments.name: test_payload
arguments.desc: Test payload. For webhooks: {"chatInput":"Test message"}. For schedules, omit to use the scheduled query.

name: toggle_csp
description: Enable or disable a contextual security policy. Inactive policies are not applied. Set enabled for the desired state; omitting it toggles the current state. Concurrent calls can race, so verify the returned is_active value.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.desc: true = ativa; false = desativa. Omitir inverte o estado atual (repetir a chamada desfaz).

name: toggle_schema
description: Enable or disable a schema without deleting it. Inactive schemas are not loaded by the agent. Set enabled for the desired state; omitting it toggles the current state. Concurrent calls can race, so verify the returned is_active value.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.desc: true = ativa; false = desativa. Omitir inverte o estado atual (repetir a chamada desfaz).

name: toggle_trigger
description: Enable or disable a trigger without deleting its configuration. Set enabled for the desired state; omitting it toggles the current state. Concurrent calls can race, so verify the returned is_active value.

arguments.name: enabled
arguments.desc: true enables the trigger; false disables it

name: unarchive_session
description: Bring an archived conversation back to the active list. `CONFLICT` if it was not archived

name: update_agent
description: Update only the supplied agent fields. memory_enabled, quick_replies_enabled and engagement_control_enabled change the agent tool surface and require admin/owner. chat_enabled controls native chat availability. Inspect partial_update if only part of the update succeeded.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the agent to update

arguments.name: chat_enabled
arguments.desc: Enable or disable the agent in native chat at chat.zihin.ai. Defaults to false.

arguments.name: engagement_control_enabled
arguments.desc: Enable the end_engagement tool so the agent can end its engagement with a consumer. A fixed response replaces model execution until the control expires. Defaults to false; independent of memory_enabled.

arguments.name: llm_config
arguments.desc: New model configuration: provider.model or auto, temperature from 0 to 2, and an ordered fallback_chain

arguments.name: memory_enabled
arguments.desc: Enable persistent agent memory (save/recall/forget_memory and automatic recall). Defaults to false. Read zihin://skills/criar-agente.

arguments.name: quick_replies_enabled
arguments.desc: Enable suggest_replies with up to four quick-reply chips. Supported by native chat and integrations declaring capabilities.blocks=["quick_replies"]. Defaults to true; disabling it avoids the extra model call.

name: update_api_key
description: Update the supplied API key settings within the caller's permissions and tenant plan limits.

arguments.name: key_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the API key to update

arguments.name: rate_limit_per_minute
arguments.desc: New requests-per-minute limit, subject to the tenant plan

name: update_approval_policy
description: Update name/description/stages or deactivate (`is_active: false`)

name: update_csp
description: Update a contextual security policy. Supplied rules replace the whole object; include all fields to retain. Check zihin://schemas/csp_config because unknown fields may be accepted without effect. Use behavior.must_not_tools for tool restrictions and require_approval_for with approval_policy_id for native-chat human approval.

arguments.name: csp_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the CSP policy to update

arguments.name: rules
arguments.desc: New rules, replacing the previous rules completely

name: update_mcp_server
description: Update only supplied MCP server fields. config replaces the whole object; send all settings to retain. Changes invalidate the agent tool surface; connection, configuration, authentication and transport changes also invalidate server tool discovery.

arguments.name: auth_method
arguments.desc: New authentication method; OAuth is not yet supported for this external-server configuration

arguments.name: integration_id
arguments.desc: Registered integration link; see list_integrations. With tunnel authentication, destination access requires an active grant. For other methods, the link is informational. Omit to preserve the current link.

name: update_schema
description: Update an agent schema using its current base_version. Supplied schema_data replaces the full document; reload and reconcile on CONFLICT.

arguments.name: schema_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the schema to update

arguments.name: base_version
arguments.desc: Recommended: version read from get_schema. A concurrent change returns CONFLICT with the current version and saves nothing; reread and reapply. Without it, the last write wins.

arguments.name: changelog
arguments.desc: Reason for the change, recorded in version history

arguments.name: schema_data
arguments.desc: Complete new schema_data in the format used by create_schema. Replaces the previous object entirely; partial updates are not supported.

name: update_secret
description: Replace a tenant secret value with a newly encrypted value. Existing references keep using the same secret name.

arguments.name: name
arguments.desc: Name of the secret to update

name: update_trigger
description: Update only supplied trigger fields. trigger_config replaces the entire configuration; read get_trigger first and include all settings to retain.

arguments.name: trigger_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the trigger to update

arguments.name: trigger_config
arguments.desc: New trigger configuration in the format used by create_trigger

name: validate_agent_schemas
description: Validate an agent's configured schemas and report errors and warnings before publication.

arguments.name: agent_id
arguments.desc: UUID of the agent to validate

name: validate_process_definition
description: Validate a process definition without saving: structure, execution rules and tenant ownership of referenced agents, approval policies and MCP servers. Returns errors with paths and reasons. Run before publishing.

arguments.name: spec
arguments.desc: Complete process definition, including key, title, description, variables_schema and steps

name: validate_schema_data
description: Dry-run: validate schema data without saving — same server-side JSON Schema validation as `create_schema`/`update_schema`. Supports all canonical types, including `trigger_config` and `csp_config`

arguments.name: schema_data
arguments.desc: Schema data to validate, using the same structure as create_schema

arguments.name: schema_type
arguments.desc: Canonical schema type to validate. trigger_config and csp_config can be validated here but are created through create_trigger and create_csp.

name: whoami
description: Identify the current session: tenant name, role, and subscription plan
